facts.value: If you are interested in completing an Erasmus+ EU Staff Training mobility, attending a Staff Week organised by one of UL's partner universities may be a good option.

metadata.chunk_title: Erasmus+ Partner Staff Weeks + Eligible duration and activities

facts.value: Staff Weeks are usually designed to give an overview of the host university's institution and departments, while bringing together teaching and non-teaching staff to share ideas and potentially establish connections for future collaboration.

metadata.chunk_title: Erasmus+ Partner Staff Weeks + Eligible duration and activities

facts.value: Many university Staff Weeks are advertised on the IMOTION website: http://staffmobility.eu/

metadata.chunk_title: Erasmus+ Partner Staff Weeks + Eligible duration and activities

facts.value: Please note that individual Staff Week participation costs are not covered under Erasmus+, with participants eligible to receive a travel grant and daily subsistence grant only under the Programme.

metadata.chunk_title: Erasmus+ Partner Staff Weeks + Eligible duration and activities

facts.value: The receiving institution must be a university with whom the University of Limerick has a signed 'inter-institutional' agreement.

facts.value: Applicants must check with UL Global prior to submitting their application to ensure the institution holds a valid mobility agreement with UL.
